subject.title: fix(sandbox): repair fs bridge stat for Codex exec-server native writes

question: Should OpenClaw accept this read-only stat expansion in the sandbox fs bridge for Codex exec-server writes?
rationale: The patch appears correct and well-proven, but it changes sandbox filesystem boundary classification where maintainer security intent is required before merge.

options.title: Require sandbox owner approval
options.body: Merge after a sandbox/CODEOWNER reviewer explicitly accepts that mount-root and directory stat handling remains metadata-only and preserves mutation guards.

options.title: Accept the boundary change as-is
options.body: A maintainer may decide the focused diff, regression tests, and live Docker proof are enough to own the remaining boundary risk.

options.title: Pause if secops review is unavailable
options.body: If no sandbox owner can review the boundary change, keep the PR open rather than landing it on bot review alone.

recommendation.title: Require sandbox owner approval
recommendation.body: Merge after a sandbox/CODEOWNER reviewer explicitly accepts that mount-root and directory stat handling remains metadata-only and preserves mutation guards.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest current-history owner for sandbox fs bridge hardening and merged the related Codex sandbox exec-server work.
